verdict: No blocker in inspected conversion semantics or current source pins. Supporting-input omission was corrected before this final review.
limits: Static code/data review only; no conversion, bake, test or browser launched.
Rasterized polygon holes are respected within each class. Another explicitly present class may still occupy a hole; blank holes are not categorically promised.
Incomparable overlapping classes remain 65535; the source-derived partial order is not a blanket arbitrary paint order.
Page raster and 0.25-degree categorical output oversample historical mapping precision and do not create new scientific resolution.
Normalized southern polar coordinates and the original GIS XY are linked by pinned registration. The bogus Earth CRS and polygon Z are not interpreted as moon geography/elevation.
